_comment: Named skill ranks (skill-progression = ranks in data/variants/variants.json). A skill climbs tier by tier: the base tier, then each later tier's name prefix ("Mega Overcharge Shot"). Inside a tier it climbs +1 to +steps; past the last step it shifts to the next tier. Rank 1 is the base skill; a bot Skill's level is its rank. Every number here is a first guess, not balance. TODO(decision: skill-ranks).
_power_comment: Power added on top of the skill's power_percent, in percent of it: step_power_percent per small step (+1, +2 ...), tier_power_percent per tier shift. A guard never blocks more than guard.max_percent in combat_tuning.json.
_uses_comment: Skill uses that take a skill from rank n to rank n + 1, in rank order: uses_to_next[0] is base to +1. One entry per rank below the top. Uses bank across fights. The jumps into a new tier (base +5 to Mega, Mega +5 to Ultra) cost the most.
_bonuses_comment: Combat skill id -> tier id -> bonus effects gained on reaching that tier (a later tier's entry replaces an earlier one). pierce_percent: ignores that share of the target's defense. weakest_bonus_percent: (all-opponent skills) that much more damage to the living opponent with the least hp. heal_guard_percent: a heal also guards its target for that share of its next hit. reflect_percent: a guard also deals that share of the damage it blocks back to the attacker.
_save_comment: A save from before ranks (format 1) held a flat level 1 to 10 at +power_percent_per_level each. It converts to the highest rank whose power is no more than that level's, so no skill grows stronger by the conversion.
